concepts.def: Skills that help you get and keep work
Doing what you said you would

walkthroughs.body_html:
Punctuality and reliability matter more than talent.

If you turn up on time and do what you promised, you're ahead of half the staff. ⏰

Almost every job needs teamwork:

  • Listen to others.
  • Share ideas.
  • Help when needed.
  • Don't take credit alone.

Great teams beat great solo stars.

Professionalism = behaving well at work:

  • Polite to everyone.
  • Tidy and presentable.
  • Confidential about company info.
  • Polite about colleagues even online. 📱

Bosses notice. So does the next employer.

mcqs.q: Always being on time is called…
What is Herzberg's distinction between hygiene factors and motivators?
options: Hygiene factors are about workplace cleanliness.
Fixed costs are the cheapest costs and variable costs are the most expensive.
Hygiene factors (pay, conditions, policies) prevent dissatisfaction when present but don't motivate; motivators (recognition, achievement, responsibility) create positive satisfaction.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between fixed and variable costs?
options: Hygiene factors are about workplace cleanliness.
Fixed costs do not change with output level (e.g. rent, salaries); variable costs change in proportion to output (e.g. raw materials, hourly wages).
Fixed costs are the cheapest costs and variable costs are the most expensive.
Fixed costs are paid every month and variable costs are paid weekly.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between primary and secondary market research?
options: Primary research is original data the business gathers itself (surveys, interviews); secondary research uses existing data (reports, government statistics, market intelligence).
Fixed costs are the cheapest costs and variable costs are the most expensive.
Primary research is done first and secondary research is done later.
Primary research is the most important and secondary research is less important.
